subject: Evening product walk-through + hands-on lab — finalizing timing & host coverage
body:
From: Sophia Nguyen <sophia.nguyen@novatek.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Evening session request — team availability (3 prospects)

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the quick intro call earlier. We have three product teams (Atlas Retail, BrightLayer, and CumulusHealth) that asked if we could join an evening demo + hands-on lab next week — they are on Pacific and Mountain time and prefer after 6pm PT.

High level asks:
- 45 min demo (capabilities + performance/cost talk) + 30 min hands-on breakout room for each prospect to test an integration sample
- Prefer Tue/Thu next week after 6pm PT (attendee windows 6:00–8:30pm PT)
- Will need two breakout rooms and a short run-of-show so our product folks can prepare

Can you confirm if Redwood can host an evening session, and who on your side would run the hands-on lab? Also, one of our sponsors will need a calendar invite they can push to execs.

Best,
Sophia
Sophia Nguyen
Partnerships, Novatek AI

---
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Sophia Nguyen <sophia.nguyen@novatek.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evening session request — team availability (3 prospects)

Hi Sophia — thanks for the context and the clear ask. We can do an evening block and run the hands-on labs.

Two proposed options (all PT):
A) Tue Apr 13, 6:15–8:00pm PT — single 45m demo (6:15–7:00) + two 20m breakouts (7:05–7:25 / 7:30–7:50) + 10m wrap
B) Thu Apr 15, 6:30–8:15pm PT — same structure but shifted later to accommodate execs

Coverage from Redwood:
- I will lead the demo and performance/cost Q&A
- Ben will run the hands-on breakouts and own the sample integration lab
- Neha will assist with the calendar invites, breakout rooms and sending a short pre-read

Attached: Evening_Demo_Agenda_v1.pdf (agenda + suggested run-of-show) and a provisional calendar ICS for Slot A. If you prefer Slot B we can send a new invite.

If that works I’ll send a consolidated calendar invite, breakout-room links, and short run-of-show.

Thanks — K

--
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai

Attachment: Evening_Demo_Agenda_v1.pdf (PDF, 82KB)
Attachment: Evening_Calendar_ICS_slotA.ics (calendar invite)

---
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sophia Nguyen <sophia.nguyen@novatek.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evening session request — team availability (3 prospects)

Kimberly — I can cover Slot A (Tue Apr 13). I’ll prepare two lab seeds: an embeddings retrieval sample and a low-latency generation pipeline with caching turned on. I’ll need a short dial-in (Zoom link) and two breakout rooms pre-provisioned.

Quick Q: do the prospects need a Docker image or a cloud sandbox? If we can pre-seed a lightweight Colab/Notebook link that would avoid install friction.

On Sat, Apr 10, 2027 at 4:05 PM Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Sophia — thanks for the context and the clear ask. We can do an evening block and run the hands-on labs.
> 
> Two proposed options (all PT):
> A) Tue Apr 13, 6:15–8:00pm PT — single 45m demo (6:15–7:00) + two 20m breakouts (7:05–7:25 / 7:30–7:50) + 10m wrap
> B) Thu Apr 15, 6:30–8:15pm PT — same structure but shifted later to accommodate execs

Thanks,
Ben

---
From: Sophia Nguyen <sophia.nguyen@novatek.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 17:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evening session request — team availability (3 prospects)

Hi Kimberly / Ben / Neha — thanks, Slot A on Tue Apr 13 works for the majority. A couple notes from the prospect organizers:
- Atlas Retail wants breakout room 1 and a short data-mapping worksheet ahead of time (they’ll have two engineers)
- BrightLayer requests breakout room 2 and would prefer the Colab option if possible
- CumulusHealth will have 1 exec + 2 engineers; they asked that the demo include a short slide on private deployment options (VPC/on-prem)

Attendees (prospects):
- Atlas Retail — events@atlasretail.com; Maya Liu (maya.liu@atlasretail.com)
- BrightLayer — chris.tan@brightlayer.io; Priet Sharma (priet@brightlayer.io)
- CumulusHealth — priya.sen@cumulushealth.org; Daniel Ortiz (dan.ortiz@cumulushealth.org)

Please send the calendar invite and breakout links. We’ll share the worksheet with Atlas and confirm headcounts tomorrow.

Best,
Sophia

---
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Sophia Nguyen <sophia.nguyen@novatek.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evening session request — team availability (3 prospects)

Thanks all — confirmed: Tue Apr 13, 6:15–8:00pm PT. I’ve created the event and included breakout rooms in the calendar invite (link below).

What I attached/sent:
- Run_of_Show_evening_demo.pdf (final) — short timestamps and host cues
- Calendar invite (slot A) — includes Zoom link, two breakout rooms and co-hosts (Ben + Neha)
- Pre-reads: Evening_Demo_Agenda_v1.pdf (copied) and a 2-slide private deployment callout for CumulusHealth

Notes / Action items:
- Ben: please upload the Colab link + two lab seeds to the shared Drive by EOD Mon so Neha can paste them into the calendar invite description
- Neha: please add the Atlas data-mapping worksheet to the invite and set the security flag to require registration email capture
- Sophia: can you confirm final headcounts per prospect by EOD Mon so we can provision breakout rooms correctly

Calendar link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-evening-demo-20270413
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/record/DEAL-2027-044-REDWOOD-01

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai

Attachment: Run_of_Show_evening_demo.pdf (PDF, 126KB)
